record.original_question: Are there any dynamical properties of W that are persistent under homotopies of the Engel structure?

evidence.quote: Question 2.14. Are there any dynamical properties of W that are persistent under homotopies of the Engel structure?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth 4-manifold. An Engel structure on $M$ is a smooth rank-2 distribution $\mathcal{D} \subset TM$ that is maximally non-integrable, in the sense that $[\mathcal{D},\mathcal{D}]$ is a rank-3 distribution $\mathcal{E}$ (an even contact structure) and $[\mathcal{E},\mathcal{E}] = TM$. Associated with such a structure is a canonically defined line field $\mathcal{W} \subset \mathcal{D}$, the kernel (Cauchy characteristic) of $\mathcal{E}$, characterized by $[\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E}] \subset \mathcal{E}$. The integral curves of $\mathcal{W}$ form a 1-dimensional foliation, and choosing a nowhere-vanishing section $W$ of $\mathcal{W}$ gives a vector field whose flow defines a dynamical system on $M$.

Two Engel structures $\mathcal{D}_0$ and $\mathcal{D}_1$ on $M$ are said to be homotopic if there exists a smooth 1-parameter family $\{\mathcal{D}_t\}_{t \in [0,1]}$ of Engel structures interpolating between them; this induces a corresponding family of characteristic line fields $\mathcal{W}_t$ and (up to choice of section) a family of vector fields $W_t$.

Identify a nontrivial dynamical invariant of the vector field $W$ (for instance, properties such as the existence of periodic orbits, minimal sets, ergodic invariant measures, topological/metric entropy, the structure of the non-wandering set, or other qualitative dynamical features) that is preserved under any homotopy of the Engel structure $\mathcal{D}$, in the sense that it is shared by every member of the family $\{W_t\}_{t \in [0,1]}$ for any homotopy $\{\mathcal{D}_t\}$. Equivalently: do there exist any dynamical properties of $W$ that are persistent under homotopies of the Engel structure?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of identifying dynamical properties of the characteristic line field of an Engel structure that are invariant under homotopies appears as an open research direction in the literature on Engel geometry and dynamics. Surveys and problem lists on Engel structures (e.g., AIM workshop problem lists, Casals–Pérez del Pino "Geometry and dynamics of Engel structures") discuss how dynamical features of the characteristic foliation can change under deformation, but no general homotopy-invariant dynamical property is known. No publication found resolves the question.

status_evidence.title: Geometry and dynamics of Engel structures
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing Engel structures and the dynamics of the characteristic foliation, including how dynamical properties depend on the structure.
status_evidence.claim: The dynamics of the characteristic foliation of Engel structures is an active topic with no known homotopy-invariant dynamical property.

status_evidence.title: AIM problem list on Engel structures
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems on Engel structures including questions about the characteristic foliation and its behavior under deformations.
status_evidence.claim: Problems concerning persistence of dynamical properties of the characteristic foliation under homotopies are listed as open.
